messages:
Alex Lawson: @Maya heads-up — AcmeSec requested an ISO-27001 applicability statement for the Private POC (VPC + customer-managed KMS). They also want CAIQ/SIG answers and a list of evidences we can share. Can we compile a short applicability + evidence pack by EOD Thu?
Maya Chen: Got it. We can produce a redacted applicability statement and CAIQ export. Need to confirm scope boundaries. Raj — can you confirm which controls we operate for Private (VPC/on-prem) vs what the customer controls?
Raj Patel: Confirming: For Private (VPC) deployments: Redwood controls the inference runtime, model serving layer, application auth, and our runtime logging/telemetry. Redwood can integrate with customer KMS for key wrapping but does not host customer keys. Customer controls the VPC, subnets, network ACLs, host OS (if on-prem), and any customer-owned storage. For ISO applicability wording we should state those boundaries explicitly.
Olivia Gomez: Draft snippet below — feel free to use. We should avoid implying we provide certification/coverage for customer-managed infra.
Olivia Gomez: ```
Applicability statement (draft):
This statement applies to Redwood Inference Private deployments (VPC and on-prem packaged deployments) and covers the Redwood-managed inference runtime, model serving components, and associated control processes operated by Redwood. In-scope: inference runtime, request auth, model artifact handling within Redwood-managed runtime, integrations with customer KMS, and Redwood operational policies (patching of runtime, vulnerability scanning, incident response for the service). Out-of-scope: customer-managed network infrastructure, customer host operating systems (for on-prem installs), and customer-owned data stores.
```
Karen (AcmeSec): Thanks — also need: encryption at rest for model cache/backups, key lifecycle docs, pen test summary, vulnerability scanning cadence, patching SLAs, user access review process, and a signed applicability statement for our vendor risk team. POC must not ingest live PII.
Maya Chen: We can provide: redacted ISMS scope doc, encryption policy, KMS architecture diagram, CAIQ export, pen-test executive summary (redacted), vulnerability scanning cadence doc, and our access review policy. We'll redact telemetry samples and customer-specific logs.
CompliBot: CAIQ_v3_Export.pdf uploaded to /shared/compliance/acme/1768904321 — https://redwood-internal/share/CAIQ_v3_Export.pdf :file_folder:
Alex Lawson: Proposed timeline: draft pack by Thu EOD, final after quick legal review by Fri morning. Karen — does that meet your vendor team's deadline?
Karen (AcmeSec): That works. Also need an applicability statement that explicitly calls out "out of scope" for customer-managed network/hosts. NDA already signed.
Raj Patel: Noted. I'll prepare the infra diagram and a short control matrix mapping Redwood controls to ISO 27001 Annex A controls (high-level). Will include which controls are customer-responsibility.
Maya Chen: I'll assemble the draft pack and upload to the secure share. @Olivia please prepare a one-page applicability PDF and a short cover email template for sales to send to the vendor team.
Olivia Gomez: On it — will post a draft link here once uploaded. :thumbsup:
Alex Lawson: Thanks team — I'll update AcmeSec and propose a POC kickoff slot once they confirm the pack.
